# AICPA & CIMA

> Professional accounting and finance education platform offering CPE courses, certifications, audit guides, and membership resources for CPAs and finance professionals.

AICPA & CIMA (Association of International Certified Professional Accountants) provides comprehensive continuing professional education, specialized credentials, and research tools for accounting and finance professionals. The platform serves individual members and accounting/finance teams with learning solutions, audit guidance, and professional development resources.

## Key Topics

- CPE Learning
- CPA Credentials
- Personal Financial Planning
- Audit Standards & Guides
- IFRS & Accounting Standards
- CFO Programme
- Risk Assessment (SAS No. 145)
- Financial Instruments Auditing
- Analytical Procedures
- AI & Automation in Accounting
- Retirement Planning
- Virtual Learning Solutions
- Professional Development
- FASB Accounting Standards Codification

## Membership & Professional Development

- [Individual Memberships](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/about/landing/individual-memberships): Individual membership overview with benefits, CPE access, and credentials
- [Personal Financial Planning (PFP) Section](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/membership/landing/personal-financial-planning-pfp-section): PFP Section membership benefits and professional resources for CPAs

## CPE Learning & Certifications

- [Retirement Planning Certificate Program Bundle](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/cpe-learning/bundle/retirement-planning-certificate-program-exam-course-bundle): Retirement Planning Certificate program bundle with six dynamic courses
- [Personal Financial Planning Courses](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/cpe-learning/personal-financial-planning): CPE learning products for personal financial planning and specialization
- [Small Business Resiliency Course](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/cpe-learning/small-business-resiliency): CPE learning course on small business resiliency and continuity planning
- [IFRS: Intangible Assets (IAS 38) Course](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/cpe-learning/course/ifrs-intangible-assets-ias-38): CPE course on IFRS intangible assets and impairment accounting standards
- [CPExpress for Accounting and Finance Teams](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/resources/landing/cpexpress-for-accounting-and-finance-teams): CPExpress landing page for accounting and finance team development

## Audit & Accounting Standards Resources

- [Analytical Procedures - Audit Guide (2025)](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/cpe-learning/publication/analytical-procedures-audit-guide): Audit guide on analytical procedures, requirements, and best practices
- [Special Considerations in Auditing Financial Instruments](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/cpe-learning/publication/special-considerations-in-auditing-financial-instruments-audit-guide-OPL): Audit guide for financial instruments with practical risk mitigation guidance
- [Essential A&A Research Collection with FASB Codification](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/cpe-learning/publication/essential-a_a-research-collection--with-fasb-accounting-standards-codification-and-gasb-library-OPL): Electronic research tool for accounting/auditing standards and FASB codification

## Webcasts & Technical Training

- [Risk Assessment Under SAS No. 145](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/cpe-learning/webcast/risk-assessment-under-sas-no-145): Webcast on risk assessment challenges and SAS No. 145 compliance
- [The AI Advantage: Leveraging AI for Efficiency and Impact](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/cpe-learning/webcast/the-ai-advantage-leveraging-ai-for-efficiency-and-impact): Webcast on AI-driven tools and strategies for accounting workflow automation
- [CFO Reporting Re-Imagined: Excel and Gen AI (Module 4)](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/cpe-learning/webcast/cfo-reporting-re-imagined-unlocking-operational-insights-with-excel-and-gen-ai-module-4-wc): Webcast on CFO reporting with Excel, Gen AI, and operational insights

## Team Learning Solutions

- [Virtual Learning Solutions for Accounting & Finance Teams](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/resources/landing/virtual-learning-solutions-for-accounting-and-finance-teams): Virtual learning solutions for accounting/finance team training and development

## Professional Insights & Articles

- [Seven Tips to Make Your Firm More Attractive During the Great Resignation](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/resources/article/seven-tips-to-make-your-firm-more-attractive-during-the-great-resignation): Article on staff retention tactics and firm management post-pandemic
- [Tips to Conquer the Next New Normal](https://www.aicpa-cima.com/resources/article/tips-to-conquer-the-next-new-normal): Article on workplace transition and hybrid work post-COVID guidance
